context.transcript:
Next on the agenda, I would like to discuss the prototype of our new refrigerator model, the Arctic Fox.
This is the first refrigerator we plan to manufacture using material that is extremely lightweight yet durable.
Unfortunately, using this new special material could add to the production costs.
So I've invited everyone from the Manufacturing Department here to get your input on modifications we can make to the production costs.
I need your suggestions on ways we can reduce production costs.
context.transcript_translation:
接下来，我想讨论我们新款冰箱型号“北极狐”（Arctic Fox）的原型机。
这是我们计划使用一种极其轻便但耐用材料制造的第一台冰箱。
不幸的是，使用这种新型特殊材料可能会增加生产成本。
所以我邀请了来自制造部门的各位来这里，听取大家关于如何修改以降低生产成本的意见。
我需要大家就如何降低生产成本提供建议。
